(3) A sequence shows the book signing event in progress, with many people sitting in chairs and a large screen displaying the book's cover and event details. (6) A group photo is taken with ChaCha and many audience members, all holding the new book in front of them. (8) He finds several of his own books on the shelf, looking pleasantly surprised and touching his chest in a gesture of emotion. (9) The video ends with a group shot of the two men talking to a fan and then a final look at the crowded bookstore event.
